issues.summary: sc2_simulator air combat is not wired: _is_air always returns False (combat.py:41-43) and weapon_air is defined but never queried. All anti-air weapons (Viking/Phoenix/Mutalisk/Corruptor/MissileTurret/SporeCrawler) effectively cannot fire. Stage 06 fixed this at the engine layer: added is_air field to UnitType, marked air units in m7_units.py, fixed _is_air/_weapon_for_target/_try_fire in combat.py.
evidence: src/projects/cmre-porting/stages/06-sim-cap-completion/result.json (runtime: G5_air_combat_wired PASS, Viking vs Viking damage_events=6)
issues.resolution: Engine-layer fix: model.py add is_air field, m7_units.py mark 15 air units, combat.py fix _is_air/_weapon_for_target/_try_fire. Verified by G5-air-wired gate (Viking vs Viking damage_events=6).

issues.summary: sc2_simulator behavior multipliers are not wired into rules: get_speed_multiplier / get_attack_speed_multiplier exist (abilities.py:361-374) but movement.py and combat.py do not call them. Also armor_add/damage_add behavior fields are stored (abilities.py:217-220) but not applied in combat. Stage 06 fixed this: movement.py calls get_speed_multiplier, combat.py calls get_attack_speed_multiplier and applies armor_add/damage_add in _compute_damage_breakdown.
issues.resolution: Engine-layer fix: movement.py step() calls get_speed_multiplier; combat.py _try_fire calls get_attack_speed_multiplier; _compute_damage_breakdown accepts attacker/target Entity and applies damage_add/armor_add from active_behaviors. Verified by G6 gates (speed_mult: 5.078->7.666; atkspd_mult: 5->8 fires; armor_add: 5120->3072 dmg; damage_add: 5120->8192 dmg).

issues.summary: Overlord (m3_units.py:238) 是 SC2 空中单位但未标记 is_air=True。stage 06 修复了 SIM-CAP-GAP-002 空战接线，但 Overlord 定义在 m3_units.py 中，不在 stage 06 的 writeScope 内（writeScope 只含 model.py / m7_units.py / combat.py / movement.py）。影响：Overlord 会被地面武器攻击（应只能被对空武器攻击）。Overlord 无武器，不影响战斗输出，但影响被攻击判定。
evidence: tools/sc2-ally-bot/src/sc2_simulator/catalog/m3_units.py:238-251 (static: Overlord 定义无 is_air 字段)
issues.resolution: Closed later by Stage 09: Overlord source definition in m3_units.py now sets is_flying=True and movement_type=MovementType.FLYING, and m7 no longer needs a dedicated Overlord flying patch. Verified by targeted regression and full tests/sc2_simulator 448/448 PASS.

issues.summary: splash 伤害使用主目标 breakdown（含主目标的 armor_add），对次要目标不重新计算护甲加成。这是 M1 既有设计近似（splash 使用主目标 final_raw * falloff），stage 06 添加 armor_add/damage_add 后使得该近似更显著：主目标有 GuardianShield 时，splash 次要目标也会受到减伤，即使它们自己没有 GuardianShield。影响场景较少（splash + 行为加成交叠），不阻塞 stage 06 完成。
evidence: tools/sc2-ally-bot/src/sc2_simulator/systems/projectile.py:273,318 (static: 弹体 splash 同样使用主目标 breakdown)
issues.resolution: Closed later by Stage 09: instant and projectile splash now recompute target-specific breakdown for each secondary target using that target's armor/attributes/behaviors. Verified by Hellion splash regression and full tests/sc2_simulator 448/448 PASS.
